title: Group A.
officialText:
Class I automatic wet standpipes shall be provided in nonsprinklered Group A buildings having an occupant
load exceeding 1,000 persons.
Exceptions:
1. Open-air-seating spaces without enclosed spaces.
2. Class I automatic dry and semiautomatic dry standpipes or manual wet standpipes are allowed in buildings where
the highest floor surface used for human occupancy is 75 feet (22 860 mm) or less above the lowest level of Fire
Department vehicle access. Dry standpipes are permitted only where subject to freezing temperatures.
